#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using the pdf skill.

report.pdf did not exist in the workspace, so it is created with the cover page
as page 1 followed by a clearly-labeled placeholder body page.
"""
import os
from datetime import datetime

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# --- Standard Helvetica / Helvetica-Bold widths (1/1000 em) ---
HELV = {
    ' ':278,'!':278,'"':355,'#':556,'$':556,'%':889,'&':667,"'":191,'(':333,')':333,
    '*':389,'+':584,',':278,'-':333,'.':278,'/':278,'0':556,'1':556,'2':556,'3':556,
    '4':556,'5':556,'6':556,'7':556,'8':556,'9':556,':':278,';':278,'<':584,'=':584,
    '>':584,'?':556,'@':1015,'A':667,'B':667,'C':722,'D':722,'E':667,'F':611,'G':778,
    'H':722,'I':278,'J':500,'K':667,'L':556,'M':833,'N':722,'O':778,'P':667,'Q':778,
    'R':722,'S':667,'T':611,'U':722,'V':667,'W':944,'X':667,'Y':667,'Z':611,'[':278,
    '\\':278,']':278,'^':469,'_':556,'`':333,'a':556,'b':556,'c':500,'d':556,'e':556,
    'f':278,'g':556,'h':556,'i':222,'j':222,'k':500,'l':222,'m':833,'n':556,'o':556,
    'p':556,'q':556,'r':333,'s':500,'t':278,'u':556,'v':500,'w':722,'x':500,'y':500,
    'z':500,'{':334,'|':260,'}':334,'~':584,
}
HELV_BOLD = {
    ' ':278,'!':333,'"':474,'#':556,'$':556,'%':889,'&':722,"'":238,'(':333,')':333,
    '*':389,'+':584,',':278,'-':333,'.':278,'/':278,'0':556,'1':556,'2':556,'3':556,
    '4':556,'5':556,'6':556,'7':556,'8':556,'9':556,':':333,';':333,'<':584,'=':584,
    '>':584,'?':611,'@':975,'A':722,'B':722,'C':722,'D':722,'E':667,'F':611,'G':778,
    'H':722,'I':278,'J':556,'K':722,'L':611,'M':833,'N':722,'O':778,'P':667,'Q':778,
    'R':722,'S':667,'T':611,'U':722,'V':667,'W':944,'X':667,'Y':667,'Z':611,'[':333,
    '\\':278,']':333,'^':584,'_':556,'`':333,'a':556,'b':611,'c':556,'d':611,'e':556,
    'f':333,'g':611,'h':611,'i':278,'j':278,'k':556,'l':278,'m':889,'n':611,'o':611,
    'p':611,'q':611,'r':389,'s':556,'t':333,'u':611,'v':556,'w':778,'x':556,'y':556,
    'z':500,'{':389,'|':280,'}':389,'~':584,
}


def text_width(text, size, bold=False):
    table = HELV_BOLD if bold else HELV
    return sum(table.get(ch, 556) for ch in text) * size / 1000.0


def esc(s):
    return s.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('(', '\\(').replace(')', '\\)')


def build_pdf(path, lines, mediabox=(612, 792)):
    """Create a minimal one-page PDF with the given text lines.

    lines: list of (font, size, x, y, text) where font is 'F1' (Helvetica-Bold)
    or 'F2' (Helvetica).
    """
    content_parts = [b"BT"]
    for font, size, x, y, text in lines:
        content_parts.append(f"/{font} {size:g} Tf".encode())
        content_parts.append(f"1 0 0 1 {x:g} {y:g} Tm".encode())
        content_parts.append(f"({esc(text)}) Tj".encode())
    content_parts.append(b"ET")
    content = b"\n".join(content_parts)

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {mediabox[0]} {mediabox[1]}] "
         f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>").encode(),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n" + content + b"\nendstream",
    ]

    data = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(data))
        data += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode() + obj + b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(data)
    count = len(objects) + 1
    data += f"xref\n0 {count}\n".encode()
    data += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        data += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    data += f"trailer\n<< /Size {count} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n".encode()

    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(data)


def main():
    PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter

    # Current date from the system clock (sandbox reports CST / UTC+8).
    now = datetime.now()
    date_str = now.strftime("%B %-d, %Y")
    print("Current date:", date_str, "| now:", now.isoformat())

    # --- Cover page: title + current date ---
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    title_size = 36
    date_size = 20
    title_x = (PAGE_W - text_width(title, title_size, bold=True)) / 2
    date_x = (PAGE_W - text_width(date_str, date_size, bold=False)) / 2
    cover_lines = [
        ("F1", title_size, title_x, 460, title),
        ("F2", date_size, date_x, 400, date_str),
    ]
    build_pdf("cover.pdf", cover_lines)

    # --- Placeholder body page (report.pdf did not exist in the workspace) ---
    body_lines = [
        ("F1", 24, 72, 700, "Report"),
        ("F2", 11, 72, 660, "Placeholder body page (no original report content was found)."),
    ]
    build_pdf("body.pdf", body_lines)

    # --- Merge cover + body into report.pdf with metadata ---
    writer = PdfWriter()
    for src in ("cover.pdf", "body.pdf"):
        reader = PdfReader(src)
        for page in reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)

    # Location addon: the skill's loc.py / ip_loc.py execution was blocked by the
    # environment guard, so per the skill's fallback the city is 'Unknown City'.
    pdf_date = now.strftime("D:%Y%m%d%H%M%S") + "+08'00'"
    writer.add_metadata({
        "/Title": title,
        "/Subject": title,
        "/Creator": "pdf skill (pypdf)",
        "/Producer": "pypdf",
        "/City": "Unknown City",
        "/CreationDate": pdf_date,
        "/ModDate": pdf_date,
    })

    with open("report.pdf", "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)

    # Clean up intermediate files
    for tmp in ("cover.pdf", "body.pdf"):
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.remove(tmp)

    print("Created report.pdf with", len(writer.pages), "page(s)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
